requirement: Consolidate the source-address dataset and characterize prior-block behaviour for the requested address-model stage.
observation_unit: One fixed candidate-day source address; addresses are not people, devices or independent incidents.
target: Descriptive construction of a retrospective case-attributed cohort; reported loss/hardware and verified targets remain distinct.
cutoff: Confirmed transaction heights strictly below each reference-payment block; entire reference block and future excluded from features.
evaluation: No fitting, control sampling or train/test split in this unit; retain the single incident group and unknown entity groups.
publication: Hashed source/payment identifiers and pinned provenance; no new bulk list of alleged victims.
